newsitem.title: USA: Santander cuts Colombia in model LatAm portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Santander cuts Colombia in model LatAm portfolio.

text.p: Santander Investments said it had cut its 12-month stance for Colombia to market weight from overweight in its model portfolio of Latin American stocks.

The firm said in a Feb 13 report, "We expect negative factors such as stepped-up competition in most quoted sectors, the still-unpredictable political environment and the lingering budget deficit issue to be a drag on an otherwise positive scenario on the interest rate and valuation fronts."
